alignments.note: The single 'No' carries both כֹּל's quantification and לֹא's negation, so the two morphemes share one discontinuous unit under rules 30 and 35, headed on the negative as a fused 'Nor' is. The competing readings give 'No' to לֹא alone with כֹּל unrepresented, or the reverse; neither leaves the other morpheme with anything.
The ASV writes no 'the' for the phrase; the determiner slot is filled by 'No' (rule 29).

The suffix of מִמֶּנּוּ is likewise unrendered; kept as its own smallest unit (rules 2, 22).

review_notes: Both clauses recast a כֹּל ... לֹא pair as a single English negative determiner; each is read as a rule 30/35 fusion headed on the negative, and the alternative single-morpheme readings are named in the unit notes.
מִמֶּנּוּ is left wholly unrendered by the ASV; its two morphemes are marked unrepresented separately under rule 2.
